bullets.title: FII Net Inflow Surges to +₹12,563.33 Cr (11 Nov Official Close)
bullets.desc: Foreign Institutional Investors recorded net cash purchases of ₹12,563.33 Cr on 11 Nov, driving combined net market liquidity to +₹4,128.80 Cr. For 12 Nov official close (15:30 IST), provisional exchange tallies publish post-session.

bullets.title: Indian Equities Market Cap Reaches Historic ₹506.65 Lakh Crore ($5.40 Trillion)
bullets.desc: Total exchange listed market capitalization touched ₹506.65 Lac Cr ($5.40 Tn as of 11-Nov-2026 close), reflecting ongoing corporate earnings strength and deep structural capital formation.

bullets.title: Market Breadth Positive at 12-Nov Session Close (2,029 Advances vs 1,475 Declines)
bullets.desc: Official exchange statistics at session close report 2,029 advancing stocks against 1,475 decliners and 103 unchanged out of 3,607 traded securities (56.3% advance ratio), demonstrating broad-based participation.

bullets.title: 100 Stocks Frozen in Upper Circuit vs 56 Lower Circuits
bullets.desc: High-momentum leadership is active across mid and small-cap industrial names, with 100 stocks locked at maximum daily upper circuit bands against 56 on the downside.

bullets.title: 78 Stocks Scale Fresh 52-Week Highs vs Only 20 Lows
bullets.desc: Stocks achieving new 52-week highs outpaced 52-week lows by nearly 4:1 (78 highs vs 20 lows), confirming persistent institutional accumulation in leading sectoral clusters.

bullets.title: Registered Investor Base Reaches Record 27.65 Crore Client Accounts
bullets.desc: Exchange data confirms total registered client accounts reached 27,65,97,533, sustaining robust retail participation and steady domestic monthly mutual fund SIP liquidity.

bullets.title: DII Institutional Activity on 11 Nov (−₹8,434.53 Cr Profit-Taking)
bullets.desc: Domestic Institutional Investors booked tactical profits of ₹8,434.53 Cr on 11 Nov as massive foreign institutional purchases (+₹12,563.33 Cr) provided ample absorption liquidity.

bullets.title: 09 Nov Session Recap: Balanced Handover (+₹39.69 Cr Combined Net)
bullets.desc: Foreign investors net bought +₹7,212.22 Cr while domestic funds net sold −₹7,172.53 Cr on 09 Nov, resulting in a balanced institutional handover with positive net bias of +₹39.69 Cr.

bullets.title: 05–06 Nov Inflow Cluster: +₹28,724 Cr Combined FII Deployment
bullets.desc: Foreign portfolios executed aggressive two-day equity allocations with +₹14,974.68 Cr on 05 Nov and +₹13,749.82 Cr on 06 Nov, establishing strong institutional support.

bullets.title: NSE Equity Segment Daily Trading Velocity
bullets.desc: Exchange telemetry highlights robust co-located trading infrastructure and orderly order-matching throughput across all institutional cash trading gateways.

bullets.title: Electronics / EMS Leaders Show Resilient Relative Strength (RS ≥ 95)
bullets.desc: High-RS momentum leaders including Dixon Technologies and Kaynes Technology continue trading near multi-month highs supported by PLI component localization and order backlogs.

bullets.title: Retail & Consumer Discretionary Networks Maintain Execution Pace
bullets.desc: Tata Group's Trent (Zudio) and consumer retail leaders maintain healthy store-level returns and pristine debt-free balance sheets heading into the second half of FY27.

screener.source: NSE Bhavcopy Settlement & Company Quarterly Filings
screener.methodology: Relative Strength (RS) score computed as weighted price momentum ranking across Nifty 500 universe (40% 3M, 30% 6M, 20% 9M, 10% 12M). Alpha calculated against relevant index (Nifty 50 for Large-Cap, Nifty Midcap 100 for Mid-Cap).

stocks.name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
takeaways: Mobile manufacturing volume scaled to 8.5M units per quarter with global anchor tech client.
Backward integration into display modules & camera assemblies expanded gross margins to 4.2%.
Component localization on track to reach 35% under PLI 2.0 incentive milestones.
stocks.guidance: FY27 Revenue target raised to ₹21,500–22,500 Cr (+48% YoY). Export order pipeline exceeds $1.2B annually.
stocks.capex: ₹550 Cr earmarked for high-density SMT lines, precision robotics, and consumer electronics capacity.

stocks.name: Trent Ltd (Tata Retail)
takeaways: Zudio store count expanded by 43 stores in Q2, taking total network to 559 stores across 164 cities.
Westside like-for-like (LFL) sales growth sustained at +12% YoY with industry-leading store-level ROCE.
Emerging lifestyle & beauty categories now contribute over 20% of standalone revenue.
stocks.guidance: Aiming for 200+ net new store additions in FY27; gross margin stability expected at 45–46%.
stocks.capex: Self-funded expansion entirely via operational cash flows; pristine debt-free balance sheet.

stocks.name: Eternal Ltd (formerly Zomato / Blinkit)
takeaways: Blinkit quick-commerce GOV surged 122% YoY with contribution margin turning positive at 3.8%.
Dark store network expanded to 791 stores; on track to cross 1,000 stores ahead of guidance.
Food delivery Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded to 3.5% of GOV with sticky consumer ordering.
stocks.guidance: Board approved ₹8,500 Cr capital raise to fortify balance sheet for rapid dark store buildout.
stocks.capex: ₹1,500 Cr capex allocated for automated regional distribution centers and cold chain warehousing.

stocks.name: KEC International Ltd
takeaways: Order book reached all-time high of ₹34,200 Cr (+19% YoY) with multi-GW transmission line awards.
EBITDA margin reached 6.8% (+60 bps YoY) on completion of legacy fixed-price railway projects.
International T&D order intake from Saudi Aramco and GCC utilities growing at 35% CAGR.
stocks.guidance: FY27 Revenue growth guided at 15–17% with full-year EBITDA margin targeting 7.5% exit run-rate.
stocks.capex: Asset-light capex model; maintenance capex contained at ₹200–250 Cr.

stocks.name: Titagarh Rail Systems Ltd
takeaways: Freight wagon production run-rate sustained at 1,000+ wagons per month with stable steel realization.
Vande Bharat commercial passenger trainset prototype on track for RDSO field trials by early 2027.
Export orders for metro carbody shells to Europe progressing with high milestone billing.
stocks.guidance: 25% Revenue CAGR guided over FY27–29 with EBITDA margins in the 11.5–12.5% bracket.
stocks.capex: ₹650 Cr capex ongoing at Uttarpara facility for stainless steel carbody fabrication & bogie testing.

stocks.name: Kaynes Technology India
takeaways: Order book swelled to ₹5,038 Cr with strong multi-year industrial and aerospace electronics contracts.
EBITDA margin expanded to 14.2% on higher mix of box-build products (now 42% of revenue).
Sanand OSAT semiconductor assembly facility received cabinet approval under ISM incentive scheme.
stocks.guidance: Guiding for 55–60% revenue growth in FY27 with sustainable 14%+ EBITDA margins.
stocks.capex: Phase 1 OSAT capex of ₹2,850 Cr over 3 years supported by 70% central and state government subsidies.

stocks.name: Varun Beverages Ltd
takeaways: BevCo South Africa acquisition integration complete; volume delivery exceeding initial forecasts.
Domestic volume growth clocked 15.5% YoY led by Sting energy drink and dairy beverage portfolio.
Operating margins sustained at 24.8% supported by backward integration in PET preforms & closures.
stocks.guidance: FY27 consolidated volume growth guided at 18–20% with strong seasonal winter stocking in Africa.
stocks.capex: Greenfield plants in Gorakhpur and Maharashtra commissioning on schedule ahead of peak summer.

stocks.name: Bharat Electronics Ltd
takeaways: Order book healthy at ₹74,595 Cr; bagged ₹7,400 Cr orders in H1 FY27 alone.
Gross margins stable at 44.5% supported by high indigenous content in electronic warfare systems.
Export revenue guided to double over next 2 fiscal years with Middle East radar orders.
stocks.guidance: FY27 revenue growth target maintained at 15% with EBITDA margin of 23–25%.
stocks.capex: ₹800 Cr capex plan for new defence systems integration facility at Nimmaluru, AP.

stocks.name: Suzlon Energy Ltd
takeaways: Order book reached all-time high of 5.1 GW with massive order from NTPC Green and private C&I clients.
Renom Energy acquisition completed, boosting multi-brand O&M services revenue and recurring cash flow.
Net cash positive balance sheet with zero debt and robust liquidity reserves.
stocks.guidance: Targeting 1.8–2.0 GW execution in FY27, expanding to 3.0 GW by FY28.
stocks.capex: Capex focused on 3.X MW turbine blade tooling and supply chain capacity debottlenecking.

stocks.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd
takeaways: GE-404 aero-engine supply delays being actively mitigated with deliveries expected to resume in Q3.
Order book stands at ₹94,000 Cr with Su-30MKI upgrade and ALH Dhruv repeat orders in pipeline.
Nashik plant ready to manufacture additional 12 Su-30MKI fighter aircraft.
stocks.guidance: Double-digit revenue growth guidance maintained for FY27 with operating margins >25%.
stocks.capex: ₹2,500 Cr annual capex towards helicopter manufacturing line in Tumakuru and engine testing cells.

stocks.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
takeaways: Order book crossed ₹5.1 lakh Cr milestone with big GCC offshore hydrocarbon contracts.
Core international EPC revenues grew 34% YoY with stable commodity escalation clauses.
Working capital intensity reduced to 12.2% of sales, driving strong operating cash generation.
stocks.guidance: FY27 order inflow growth guided at 15% with international pipeline exceeding ₹4 lakh Cr.
stocks.capex: Capex directed towards green hydrogen electrolyzer giga-factory in Hazira.

stocks.name: Coforge Ltd
takeaways: Order intake exceeded $516M for 3rd straight quarter; 12 new large accounts added.
BFS and Travel verticals sustained double-digit sequential growth despite US macro.
Cigniti acquisition integration completed ahead of timeline with cross-sell synergy.
stocks.guidance: Guiding for industry-leading 13–14% CC organic revenue growth in FY27.
stocks.capex: Delivery center expansion across Hyderabad and Noida to support AI engineering teams.

stocks.name: Polycab India Ltd
takeaways: Domestic cables & wires institutional demand fueled by national real estate & power transmission.
FMEG business operating losses reduced; on track for break-even in H2 FY27.
International exports contributed 10.5% of total revenue with certifications in US/EU.
stocks.guidance: Management targets ₹20,000 Cr revenue milestone under Project Leap framework.
stocks.capex: ₹800–900 Cr capex ongoing for extra-high-voltage (EHV) underground cable facility.

stocks.name: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders
takeaways: Submarine and stealth frigate construction progressing ahead of standard shipyard delivery benchmarks.
Defence Ministry RFP for 3 additional Scorpene submarines valued at ₹20,000+ Cr in commercial negotiations.
Commercial ship repair revenue growing at 32% with drydock capacity operating at 95% utilization.
stocks.guidance: 15–18% annual revenue CAGR expected over FY27–29 with industry-leading EBITDA margins of 22%.
stocks.capex: ₹900 Cr earmarked for modern submarine drydock expansion and robotics welding berths in Mumbai.

stocks.name: Solar Industries India
takeaways: Pinaka rocket propellant delivery run-rate accelerated with MoD emergency procurement orders.
International commercial explosives market share in South Africa and Australia expanding rapidly.
Counter-drone loitering munition (Nagastra-1) supplies begun to Indian Army forward divisions.
stocks.guidance: Defence segment revenue projected to surge 45% in FY27, comprising 28% of overall corporate revenue.
stocks.capex: ₹600 Cr greenfield propellant synthesis facility commissioning in Nagpur.

stocks.name: Persistent Systems Ltd
takeaways: Order bookings hit record $528M ACV; enterprise AI implementation deal sizes expanding.
Healthcare and Life Sciences vertical grew 22% YoY with marquee US hospital network wins.
Operating margins improved 70 bps QoQ to 14.8% due to higher offshore delivery leverage.
stocks.guidance: Guiding for top-quartile revenue growth in FY27 with margin expansion of 100 bps by FY28.
stocks.capex: AI engineering center in Texas and India delivery capacity expansion.

stocks.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
takeaways: Blended ARPU climbed to ₹233 per month following industry tariff hikes with minimal subscriber churn.
Homes broadband added 580k subscribers; Airtel Business enterprise cloud services grew 14% YoY.
Africa business currency devaluation headwinds subsiding; ROCE touched 17.5%.
stocks.guidance: Management targeting ₹300 ARPU over medium term; 5G capex cycle largely peaked in FY26.
stocks.capex: Moderating 5G capex to ₹24,000 Cr in FY27, yielding strong free cash flow conversion.

stocks.name: Samvardhana Motherson International
takeaways: Order book for automotive wiring harnesses and vision systems touched record €38.5B.
Content per vehicle expanded across premium European and Indian passenger electric vehicles.
Recent strategic acquisitions in aerospace and consumer electronics turning EPS accretive.
stocks.guidance: On track for $36B corporate gross revenues target by FY28 with ROCE targeting 20%.
stocks.capex: Annual capex of ₹4,000 Cr focused on localized wiring harness capacity in India and Mexico.

stocks.name: HDFC Bank Ltd
takeaways: Credit-to-Deposit (LDR) ratio normalized down to 99.8% as deposit mobilization outpaced advances.
Net Interest Margin (NIM) held resilient at 3.46% with declining wholesale borrowing dependence.
Gross NPA contained at pristine 1.36% with zero systemic asset quality stress.
stocks.guidance: Management expects deposit growth of 17–19% to drive gradual loan growth acceleration in H2 FY27.
stocks.capex: Investments in digital banking stack and addition of 400 branches in semi-urban India.

stocks.name: State Bank of India
takeaways: Quarterly Net Profit surpassed ₹18,000 Cr mark, maintaining return on assets (ROA) above 1.1%.
SME and retail loan book expanded 18% YoY with ultra-low credit costs of 38 bps.
Corporate loan sanction pipeline robust at ₹4.8 lakh Cr driven by power, roads, and metals capex.
stocks.guidance: 14–16% loan growth guided for FY27 with domestic NIMs defended around 3.25–3.30%.
stocks.capex: Digital YONO 2.0 modernization and technology resilience infrastructure upgrades.

stocks.name: Tata Power Company Ltd
takeaways: Tirunelveli solar cell and module plant operating at full 4.3 GW rated capacity with strong captive absorption.
Rooftop solar order book surged to ₹3,200 Cr under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana tailwinds.
Transmission assets operational availability recorded at 99.8% with stable regulated return.
stocks.guidance: Targeting 20 GW clean energy portfolio by 2030; renewable EBITDA contribution to cross 50% by FY28.
stocks.capex: ₹20,000 Cr planned capex in FY27 directed towards pumped storage projects and hybrid renewable tenders.

results.source: BSE/NSE Reg. 33 Corporate Earnings Filings (Q2 FY27)

items.name: Dixon Technologies
items.remark: Landmark Q2 FY27 results driven by exponential smartphone and display manufacturing volumes under PLI 2.0. High institutional delivery volume (4.2x 20DMA) on result day; stage-2 trend intact (F&O stock without static price band).

items.name: KEC International Ltd
items.remark: Operational beat with 46% PAT growth and 180 bps margin expansion. Order book reached all-time high of ₹34,200 Cr (+19% YoY) driven by domestic and GCC grid infrastructure.

items.name: Trent Ltd (Tata Retail)
items.remark: Zudio network additions sustained with strong store-level ROCE (>45%). Resilient institutional accumulation near all-time high; operating cash flows fully self-funding capex.

items.name: Bharat Electronics Ltd
items.remark: Indigenization tailwinds driving record electronic warfare order conversion. Order book healthy at ₹74,595 Cr; export pipeline expanding across Middle East and Southeast Asia.

items.name: Coforge Ltd
items.remark: Leading execution in mid-tier IT. Order intake exceeded $500M for third consecutive quarter; Cigniti synergy realization tracking ahead of schedule.

items.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
items.remark: Core international EPC execution up 34% YoY with stable commodity pass-through clauses. Order backlog surpassed ₹5.1 lakh Cr across power, infrastructure, and offshore hydrocarbons.

items.name: Polycab India Ltd
items.remark: Topline in line with expectations with steady institutional cable volume. FMEG segment narrowing losses; holding comfortably above 50 SMA support.

items.name: Tata Power Company Ltd
items.remark: Tirunelveli 4.3 GW cell/module plant operating at full rated utilization. Rooftop solar order book expanded to ₹3,200 Cr under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana.

items.name: Infosys Ltd
items.remark: Met conservative guidance, though large discretionary financial tech client transformation spending remains selective.

items.name: Bajaj Consumer Care
items.remark: Rural consumer demand sluggishness and competitive pricing pressure compressed operating margins. High-volume selling; broke below 200 SMA.

items.name: Vodafone Idea Ltd
items.focus: 4G/5G capex deployment progress, AGR payment discussions & subscriber ARPU trajectory.

items.name: Eicher Motors Ltd
items.focus: Royal Enfield 450cc and 650cc dispatch run-rates & VECV commercial vehicle operating margins.

items.name: Hero MotoCorp Ltd
items.focus: Post-festive 2-wheeler inventory normalization, rural recovery, and Vida electric scooter market share.

items.name: Grasim Industries Ltd
items.focus: Birla Opus paints capacity ramp-up milestones & standalone VSF/chemical EBITDA spreads.

items.name: Hindustan Aeronautics
items.focus: Tejas Mk1A delivery schedules, Su-30MKI upgrade execution & indigenous helicopter engine testing.
